text:
Maya (People Ops): FYI - Casey (Sr Infra PM) starts Monday 9am PT. Putting the manager-level "passport" and a short who-to-ask list here so Jordan has a single place to check.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks Maya. Goal: quick 20m intro + 30m deep-dive with infra tech lead. Can we get Casey's laptop and cloud access before the start?
Alex (IT): Already queued the device order. Jordan - confirm mac vs linux, and any docking peripherals. Also tell me which Slack channels to auto-invite.
Jordan (Eng Manager): MacBook Pro 14, USB-C dock, extra monitor. Invite to #infra, #oncall, and #infra-announcements. AWS roles: infra-read, infra-deploy (dev only), gh-org.
Maya (People Ops): Adding to checklist. Manager passport (copy-able):
```
Manager passport - day0/day1 actions:
- Submit device order + Okta account (IT)
- Slack invite + calendar welcome (People Ops)
- Payroll + tax forms complete (People Ops)
- Badge + office tour scheduled (Office Ops)
- MFA + SSO verification (IT/Security)
- 1:1 scheduled daily stand short cadence (manager/buddy)
- Mini onboarding task assigned (manager) - low-risk infra task to land by day 3
```
Rae (Onboarding Buddy): I'll take the buddy role. I'll send Casey a "first-week map" with links, who-to-ask matrix, and a 1-pager on team services. Planning an informal intro + lunch Mon 12pm.
Jordan (Eng Manager): For the mini onboarding task: rotate a demo secret in the sandbox and open a PR that exercises the deploy pipeline. Teaches cred handling + CI.
Sam (Security): Approved. We'll provide a 10-min "secrets hygiene" walkthrough and a pre-read doc ('secrets-quickstart.md'). Also we'll create a short-lived token flow for sandbox access (no prod creds).
Alex (IT): Will provision sandbox service account with least-privilege and set token TTL to 1 hour. I'll DM Casey the steps and link to ephemeral token page.
Maya (People Ops): People Ops checklist (high level):
- Before start: offer & tax forms signed, device ordered, Slack + calendar invites sent.
- Day 0: welcome email + intro doc, access smoke test (Okta + Slack + email).
- Day 1: 30m manager intro, buddy meet, badge, quick security 10m.
- Week 1: assign small task, schedule 1:1s, runbooks tour, infra shadowing.
- 30/60/90 expectations: 30 - map key services & runbook familiarity; 60 - own a backlog slice; 90 - lead a reliability improvement and present to team.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Can we add a line to the manager passport about feedback checkpoints? I'm planning 1:1s at day3, week2, week4, then monthly.
Maya (People Ops): Added. Also please upload signed offer to #people-ops-private for records.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Will do. Also requesting a 15-min sync with platform lead on Tue to go over current incidents & priorities.
Rae (Onboarding Buddy): Team intro schedule: Mon 10am 2-min intros from everyone, Mon 3pm shadow oncall, Wed 11am architecture overview. I'll put invites out.
People Ops Bot: New-hire checklist created: https://okta.example/onboard/2185001111 :tada:
Sam (Security): Sending the pre-read now. Will host the live 10-min at Mon 4pm.
Alex (IT): ETA for laptop image: deployed and labeled "Casey - MacBook Pro" by Friday EOD.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks all. This passport is great 8522; anything I'm missing?
Maya (People Ops): Maybe add a note to confirm non-competes/contract addenda if needed, but otherwise this looks complete. Good luck Casey! :seedling:
